name: Antimanual – AI Support Chatbot with Docs, Search & Auto-Posting Tools
author: Spider Themes

sections.description:
Antimanual is a powerful AI-driven WordPress plugin designed to enhance user experience, automate support, and improve content organization. It works seamlessly with any WordPress theme or plugin.

Features:

  • AI Chatbot: Trained from your docs, posts, pages, URLs, PDFs, and more to deliver fast, accurate answers.
  • AI Doc Generator: Instantly creates clean documentation with your chosen language, tone, structure, and optimized slug settings.
  • Bulk Rewrite: Generates bulk terms, excerpts, and tags to improve SEO, readability, organization, and overall site clarity.
  • bbPress Forum Automation: Converts closed topics into helpful posts and generates smart AI replies for better forum engagement.
  • Knowledge Base: Builds an organized knowledge system by converting usable content sources into structured, searchable, AI-ready resources.
  • Auto Posting: Automatically publishes fresh posts using your chosen topics, tone, and schedule to keep content active effortlessly.
  • AI Search: Adds a customizable AI-powered search block with editable text, buttons, and icons for improved discovery.
  • 9+ Embed Model Options: Uses multiple embed model choices to process docs data and deliver precise, context-aware AI responses.
    Perfect for: WordPress site owners, documentation managers, and businesses looking to reduce support workload and increase user engagement.

🔗 USEFUL LINKS

  • Get Antimanual Premium
  • Documentation
  • Support Forum
sections.installation:
1. Upload the antimanual folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure the AI settings under Antimanual > Settings.
  4. Add your OpenAI API key to enable AI features.
  5. Start leveraging AI-powered features!
sections.faq:
What does this plugin do?

Antimanual provides AI-powered features including an intelligent chatbot trained on your content and automated taxonomy generation for better content organization and SEO.

What AI model does the chatbot use?

The chatbot is trained using your WordPress content, ensuring contextually relevant responses.

Can I customize the taxonomy generation rules?

Yes! You can define custom conditions for taxonomy generation based on post metadata.

What API is used for AI functionalities?

The plugin uses OpenAI’s API to power all the AI features and functionality.
